answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the signal of a task receipt, and the raven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
